6	import Mathlib
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.SymPowAffineCarrier
8	
9	/-!
10	# Milne III.3.1's affine half, with the carrier named: `Sym^n (Spec_k A) = Spec_k (A^{⊗n})^{S_n}`
11	
12	This file writes the composition that `Albanese/SymPowAffineCarrier.lean`'s Scope section named
13	as the one thing still separating the two named ends of the affine picture, and that
14	`Albanese/SymPowColimit.lean` §5 flags in bold as "**The carrier is not named in Lean.**"
15	
16	Three landed results, none of which was enough alone:
17	
18	* `SymPowInvariantsUnder.hasColimit_actionDiagramUnder_op` — the quotient of the `S_n`-action
19	  **on the tensor power** is `op` of the invariant subalgebra. The *output*, named, but as a
20	  diagram indexed by `(SingleObj G)ᵒᵖ`.
21	* `SymPowAffineCarrier.tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj` — the `n`-fold product in `(Under k)ᵒᵖ` that
22	  `permDiagram` is built on **is** `op` of the tensor power, with the actions matched. The
23	  *input*, named.
24	* `SymPowInvariantsUnder.hasColimit_singleObj_of_op` — the index-category transport, along
25	  `Groupoid.invEquivalence`.
26	
27	What this file does is note that the three compose, and that the composition is a diagram
28	**isomorphism** rather than a chain of rewrites: `permDiagram (op (mkUnder k A)) n` and the
29	transported action diagram agree at the object by `tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj` and at every map by
30	`permAut_eq_op_permAlgHom`, so `NatIso.ofComponents` applies and `hasColimit_of_iso` transports.
31	
32	## Main results
33	
34	* `transportedActionDiagram` — the action diagram on `⨂[k] _ : Fin n, A`, transported to the
35	  index category `SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))` that `permDiagram` uses.
36	* `transportedActionDiagram_map` — its map at `σ` is `op (permAlgHom σ)`, on the nose after one
37	  `Under.forget`/`CommRingCat.hom_ext` peel. Note the variance: **no inverse here**, because the
38	  two inversions in the chain (`permMulSemiringAction` acts through `σ⁻¹`, and the
39	  `invEquivalence` reindexes by `σ ↦ σ⁻¹`) cancel.
40	* `permDiagramIsoTransportedAction` — **the diagram isomorphism**, the content of this file.
41	* `hasColimit_permDiagram_op_mkUnder` — a stepping stone, **not** a new fact: cocompleteness
42	  already gives this instance (`infer_instance` discharges it). Its value is that its proof
43	  factors through the named vertex.
44	* `colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed` — **the deliverable.** The colimit of the `S_n`-action on
45	  `(Spec_k A)^n` **is** `Spec_k ((A^{⊗ n})^{S_n})`. An equation between the anonymous colimit and
46	  a named object, so — unlike the `HasColimit` above — it is not obtainable from cocompleteness.
47	
48	An earlier draft offered instead a restatement of `symPowData_affineAlgebra` "reached through"
49	the new instance. That was vacuous: the statement is literally the old one, and which proof
50	supplied the instance is invisible in it. Naming an object requires a statement that mentions the
51	object.
52	
53	## The variance ledger, because this cone has got it wrong twice
54	
55	Four inversions appear along this chain and they must be counted, not guessed:
56	
57	1. `permEnd C n σ = permAut C σ⁻¹` (the `End`-multiplication convention);
58	2. `permMulSemiringAction` acts by `σ • x = permAlgHom σ⁻¹ x`;
59	3. `invEquivalence` reindexes the transported diagram by `σ ↦ σ⁻¹`;
60	4. `inj i ≫ permAlgHom e = inj (e⁻¹ i)`, which forces `permAut_eq_op_permAlgHom` to pair
61	   `permAut e` with `permAlgHom e⁻¹`.
62	
63	(2) and (3) cancel, leaving `transportedActionDiagram_map` inverse-free; (1) and (4) cancel in
64	the naturality square, which is why it closes by `permAut_eq_op_permAlgHom` after one `inv_inv`
65	and no further bookkeeping. Every step was checked against the kernel; the `e⁻¹` in (4) was got
66	backwards on the first attempt in the sibling file and caught by a residual goal that is true
67	only at an involution.
68	
69	## Scope — the curve is untouched
70	
71	**Does**: name the affine carrier. `SymPowColimit.lean` §5's bold caveat is now dischargeable,
72	and the honest statement of Milne III.3 Proposition 3.1's affine half — the object, not merely
73	its existence — is `symPowData_affine_named` together with `SymPowInvariantsUnder.fixedUnder`.
74	
75	**Does not**: touch the gluing. `HasColimit (permDiagram C n)` for a proper curve `C` in
76	`Over (Spec k̄)` is a statement about a non-affine object, and nothing here bears on it —
77	`AlbaneseUP.lean`'s six sorries are unchanged and `albanese_universal_property` still reports
78	`sorryAx`. Milne's route from here is to glue these affine quotients over an open affine cover
79	of the curve (`SymPowColimit.lean` §6's availability table), which needs their compatibility on
80	overlaps and is the remaining item of `StableAffineCoverGroup.lean`'s four-item bill.
81	
82	## References
83	
84	Milne, *Abelian Varieties*, §III.3 Proposition 3.1, p. 94.
85	-/

98	variable (k : CommRingCat.{0}) (A : Type) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (n : ℕ)
99	
100	/-- The cartesian structure on `(Under k)ᵒᵖ`, spelled the way `symPowData_affineAlgebra` spells
101	it — `ofHasFiniteProducts`, not a bound `[CartesianMonoidalCategory _]` hypothesis.
102	
103	**This is load-bearing and not stylistic.** With the instance *bound*, `permDiagram`'s object
104	`∏ᶜ` and `tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj`'s codomain are `rfl`-equal but not syntactically equal, and the
105	naturality `rw` fails with "not type-correct under the `instances` transparency level" — the
106	project's recorded `rfl`-equal-spellings trap. Pinning the concrete instance makes both sides one
107	term. It also matches the consumer, which is the reason to prefer it anyway. -/
108	noncomputable local instance instCartesianUnderOp :
109	    CartesianMonoidalCategory (Under k)ᵒᵖ := ofHasFiniteProducts
110	
111	/-! ## §1. The action diagram, on the index category `permDiagram` uses
112	
113	`hasColimit_actionDiagramUnder_op` is about a diagram over `(SingleObj G)ᵒᵖ`. Precomposing with
114	`Groupoid.invEquivalence` lands it over `SingleObj G`, which is `permDiagram`'s index category.
115	The reindexing is `σ ↦ σ⁻¹` — see the variance ledger in the module header for why the result is
116	nevertheless inverse-free. -/
117	
118	/-- **The transported action diagram.** The `S_n`-action on `⨂[k] _ : Fin n, A` over the base,
119	dualised into `(Under k)ᵒᵖ` and reindexed onto `SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))`. -/
120	noncomputable def transportedActionDiagram :
121	    SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) ⥤ (Under k)ᵒᵖ :=
122	  letI := permMulSemiringAction (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
123	  letI := permSMulCommClass (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
124	  (Groupoid.invEquivalence (SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)))).functor
125	    ⋙ (actionDiagramUnder k (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (⨂[(k : Type)] _ : Fin n, A)).op
126	
127	/-- **The transported diagram's map is `op (permAlgHom σ)`, with no inverse.**
128	
129	The two inversions in the chain cancel: `permMulSemiringAction` acts through `σ⁻¹`, and
130	`invEquivalence` reindexes by `σ ↦ σ⁻¹`. The proof peels `Under.forget` and `CommRingCat.hom_ext`
131	and is then `rfl` — the cancellation is definitional, not a rewrite. -/
132	theorem transportedActionDiagram_map (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
133	    (transportedActionDiagram k A n).map (SingleObj.toEnd (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) σ)
134	      = ((permAlgHom (k : Type) A σ).toUnder).op := by
135	  apply Quiver.Hom.unop_inj
136	  apply (Under.forget k).map_injective
137	  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
138	  ext x
139	  rfl
140	
141	/-! ## §2. The diagram isomorphism
142	
143	Object: `tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj`. Maps: `permAut_eq_op_permAlgHom`. That is the whole content —
144	which is the point, since the two halves were landed separately and never compared. -/
145	
146	/-- **The comparison of diagrams.** `permDiagram (op (mkUnder k A)) n` — the diagram whose
147	colimit `symPowData_affineAlgebra` takes — is isomorphic to the transported action diagram on the
148	tensor power.
149	
150	Naturality is `permAut_eq_op_permAlgHom` after `inv_inv`: `permDiagram`'s map at `σ` is
151	`permAut σ⁻¹` by the `permEnd` convention, and that pairs with `permAlgHom σ`. -/
152	noncomputable def permDiagramIsoTransportedAction :
153	    transportedActionDiagram k A n
154	      ≅ permDiagram (Opposite.op (CommRingCat.mkUnder k A)) n :=
155	  NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ => tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj k A n) (by
156	    intro X Y f
157	    obtain rfl : X = SingleObj.star _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
158	    obtain rfl : Y = SingleObj.star _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
159	    -- State each side with `.map f` and let unification supply the `toEnd`: writing
160	    -- `toEnd _ f` in the rewrite makes the pattern syntactically distinct from the goal
161	    -- (see the `instCartesianUnderOp` docstring — the same spelling trap, one layer up).
162	    have h1 : (transportedActionDiagram k A n).map f
163	        = ((permAlgHom (k : Type) A (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))).toUnder).op :=
164	      transportedActionDiagram_map k A n _
165	    have h2 : (permDiagram (Opposite.op (CommRingCat.mkUnder k A)) n).map f
166	        = MonObj.permAut (Opposite.op (CommRingCat.mkUnder k A))
167	            (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))⁻¹ := rfl
168	    rw [h1, h2]
169	    have h := permAut_eq_op_permAlgHom k A n (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))⁻¹
170	    rw [inv_inv] at h
171	    exact h.symm)
172	
173	/-! ## §3. The payoff: the colimit comes from the invariants
174	
175	`symPowData_affineAlgebra` obtains its colimit from `(Under k)ᵒᵖ`'s cocompleteness, so its
176	carrier is an anonymous `colimit` and Milne's `(A^{⊗n})^{S_n}` appears nowhere. **The fix is not
177	a second proof of the same `HasColimit`** — that changes nothing provable, as the next docstring
178	records — but an *equation* between the colimit object and the named one, which is
179	`colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed` at the end of this section. The `HasColimit` below is a stepping
180	stone to it, not the deliverable. -/
181	
182	/-- **`HasColimit` for the affine chart, proved through the named vertex.**
183	
184	`(Under k)ᵒᵖ` is cocomplete, so this instance is available without this file — `infer_instance`
185	discharges it, measured — and **this theorem is therefore not a new fact and not the point.** Its
186	only role is that its proof factors through `permDiagramIsoTransportedAction`, which is what
187	`colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed` then needs. Do not cite it as progress on naming the carrier; cite
188	the iso. -/
189	theorem hasColimit_permDiagram_op_mkUnder :
190	    HasColimit (permDiagram (Opposite.op (CommRingCat.mkUnder k A)) n) := by
191	  letI := permMulSemiringAction (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
192	  letI := permSMulCommClass (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
193	  haveI : HasColimit (transportedActionDiagram k A n) := by
194	    haveI := hasColimit_actionDiagramUnder_op k (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
195	      (⨂[(k : Type)] _ : Fin n, A)
196	    infer_instance
197	  exact hasColimit_of_iso (permDiagramIsoTransportedAction k A n).symm
198	
199	/-! ### The statement that actually names the carrier
200	
201	**A probe, and a correction to what this file first claimed.** A draft of this file offered
202	`symPowData_affine_named : ∃ D, ∀ σ, permAut ≫ D.proj = D.proj` as its payoff, on the grounds
203	that it was "reached through `hasColimit_permDiagram_op_mkUnder`". That was worthless: the
204	statement is *identical* to `symPowData_affineAlgebra` instantiated at `op (mkUnder k A)`, and
205	which proof produces the instance is invisible in it. Worse, `infer_instance` discharges
206	`HasColimit (permDiagram (op (mkUnder k A)) n)` on its own from cocompleteness — measured — so
207	even `hasColimit_permDiagram_op_mkUnder` adds nothing to what is *provable*; its only value is
208	that its proof factors through the named vertex.
209	
210	Naming the carrier therefore has to be an **equation about the colimit object**, which is the
211	theorem below. That is the one statement in this cone that mentions Milne's `(A^{⊗ n})^{S_n}` and
212	the diagram whose colimit `symPowData_affineAlgebra` takes, in the same sentence. -/
213	
214	/-- **Milne III.3 Proposition 3.1, affine half, with the object identified.**
215	
216	The colimit of the `S_n`-action on `(Spec_k A)^n` — the very diagram
217	`SymPowColimit.symPowData_affineAlgebra` takes a colimit of — is `Spec_k` of the invariant
218	subalgebra `(A^{⊗ n})^{S_n}`.
219	
220	This is what `SymPowColimit.lean` §5's bold caveat "**The carrier is not named in Lean**" asked
221	for, and unlike the `HasColimit` statement above it is not obtainable from cocompleteness: it is
222	an equation between the anonymous colimit and a named object, so it needs both
223	`permDiagramIsoTransportedAction` (this file) and `fixedCoconeUnderIsColimitOp`
224	(`SymPowInvariantsUnder`).
225	
226	Two colimits of isomorphic diagrams, composed with `whiskerEquivalence` to absorb the
227	index-category transport. -/
228	noncomputable def colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed :
229	    letI := permMulSemiringAction (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
230	    letI := permSMulCommClass (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
231	    haveI := hasColimit_permDiagram_op_mkUnder k A n
232	    colimit (permDiagram (Opposite.op (CommRingCat.mkUnder k A)) n)
233	      ≅ Opposite.op (fixedUnder k (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (⨂[(k : Type)] _ : Fin n, A)) := by
234	  letI := permMulSemiringAction (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
235	  letI := permSMulCommClass (k : Type) (ι := Fin n) A
236	  haveI := hasColimit_permDiagram_op_mkUnder k A n
237	  refine (HasColimit.isoOfNatIso (permDiagramIsoTransportedAction k A n).symm) ≪≫ ?_
238	  exact (colimit.isColimit _).coconePointUniqueUpToIso
239	    (IsColimit.whiskerEquivalenceEquiv _ (fixedCoconeUnderIsColimitOp k (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
240	      (⨂[(k : Type)] _ : Fin n, A)))
241	
242	end AffineQuotient
243	
244	end PiTensorProduct
